title: Filing an appeal to the State Commission

content.scenario: A consumer in India has received an order from the District Commission, and they want to appeal it to the State Commission. The consumer has prepared the appeal in the prescribed form and manner and files it with the State Commission within forty-five days from the date of the order of the District Commission.
content.outcome: The State Commission will consider the appeal and make a decision based on the facts and law.

user_queries: How to file an appeal to the State Commission?
What is the process for filing an appeal to the State Commission?
